goal: Implement the complete integrated FabQuality application against PROBLEM.md and the protected diagnostic contract, then pass every fixed acceptance ID.

requirements.text: Implement all PROBLEM.md requirements together through fabquality.app.create_app and the protected implementation contract; CPU single process in-memory, deterministic explanation-only stub, local mock, no external API.

Generate 4 calibration and 8 evaluation real 128x128 8-bit L PNG pairs with independent fixed seeds; noise <=5, addition/removal injections on appropriate pixels, independent truth masks; no label/filename/seed-based detection.
Signed abs diff >32, total candidates >=4 defect, full union mask and half-open bbox; normal zero final mask; cover 32/33 and 3/4 boundaries and disconnected candidates.

Validate typed ontology node/relation uniqueness, references, allowed directions/cardinalities, offset-aware ended_at and policy types/thresholds/queues at startup; static 2 equipment,6 LOT,8 runs,2 policies, only Inspection/INSPECTS added per case.
Traverse same-equipment inclusive event-time 60 minute window, exclude future/other equipment, sort unique LOTs while preserving every valid run path, node/relation IDs and both times.
Code-built immutable draft and policy evidence; policy A 64/3, B 128/4, pixel OR unique LOT thresholds, 63/64/65 and LOT2/3/4; approved draft and queue preserved in actual mock ticket.

All five public HTTP endpoints and snapshot fields, approval barrier zero mock calls, valid state transitions, same decision retransmission, opposite 409, terminal no-op; BLOCKED preserves completed results per Q-002/005.

Actual mock calls once per approved step, attempts increment before call, normal/after_commit_once/always_fail modes, idempotent case+draft ticket, changed draft rejected, retry twice then third failure FAILED; preserve errors/history/results.

Input handling actual PNG, each file <=1MiB, 413 takes priority per Q-003/006, invalid fields/channel/size/PNG/run 422 with no case, event dedup by decoded arrays/run, conflict409/notfound404, distinct event same run separate.

Independent eval/run executes all original 10 scenarios in fresh state, isolated live cases, fixed image/LOT/path/automation/policy metrics, numerator/denominator and null for zero denominator, diagnostic masks/paths/history for failures.

Use only PROBLEM.md scope with SELECTION_REFERENCE excluded per diagnostic Q-001/004; never claim official examiner answers. Supplementary practice data is not the original evaluation pairs and no truth masks/labels enter service judgement.

README data/run/eval commands, requirement code mapping, execution evidence and unverified scope; INTERVIEW bottlenecks/assumptions/success criteria truthfully, HANDOFF current status, distinguish image anomaly/related LOT/confirmed defect; use Python3.9 unittest, pinned requirements and logged commands; do not alter protected tests/contracts/spec/answers/harness/prompts/criteria/models or fabricate reviews.
